row.notes: Maps penalty/infringement type to HUD string keys: safety_rating_* and penalty_* for drive_through, stop_go, grid, reminder, time, warning, disqualified, removed_from_formation_lap, parked_too_long_timer, tyre_regulations, plus tt_lap_invalid, tt_this_next_lap_invalid, tt_this_previous_lap_invalid, penalty_speed_limit ('<INVALID>' default). Callers Game_Hud_BuildInfringementMessage (0x142a4ef5d), Game_Hud_QueueMessage. Addon-relevant: penalty type names.
